title: 第19章 清风城血夜第20章 灭门之夜姐弟情深
slug: 朝廷鹰犬没挨过六扇门的刀
content_zh:
清风城血夜
树林
黑色不明物体成群结队的快速移动，等到跟前才发现，他们居然是一道道人影。
“武者确实比军人好用多了。”李君肃看着气都不喘的武者们，思索着。
“出发。”而後，李君肃看着远方的黑夜说道。
清风城，城门。
“现在开城门没问题吗？”一名守卫问着另一名守卫。
“上面的事，我们少管。”另一名守卫语焉不详的开口。
而後，他们就看到了一道道黑影从远处掠来，而後一往无前的冲≈x38c9;城门。
“清风城，要变天了。”
李家，大门外。
“来了。”李毅年看着远处秩序井然前来的黑影们淡淡道。
而後，黑影们尽皆落地，为首的年轻人起身。
“家主，长老。”李君肃看着大门外的人拱手。
“慎行！”还没等李毅年他们回答，一道身影猛得冲出，就抱住了李君肃。
哪怕李君肃再怎麽不一样，她也还是会担心的。
“意姐，我回来了。”李君肃感受着熟悉的怀抱，挣扎着。
而後，李清风看向李毅年，长老们也纷纷看向李毅年。
“呃孩子之间关系好是正常的。”李毅年硬着头皮开口。
他也是发现了，李君意跟慎行的关系好的有点太过分了。

但李清风倒是不置可否的点了点头，这两小家伙知道分寸。
特别是这雕鴞。
“家主，请下令吧。”李君肃好说歹说才把李君意劝下来，而後单膝跪地。
“先起来，你想先去林家？”李清风看着自家英俊的孙子满意开口。
这孩子，随自己，老一辈的隔代亲本能发作了。
“是，林家家主实力不弱，围剿楚家，高端比低端更有用。”李君肃低头，利弊陈害。
“而且清风城只需要一个李家就够了。”李君肃说出真实想法。
“好一个清风城只需要李家就够了，李武，老三老四，你们跟雕鴞去林家。”李清风闻言大笑。
“至於老二，你就跟小年围住楚家，一旦楚家被惊动，那就动手。”李清风一挥手。
“记住，速战速决。”李清风看着李君肃叮嘱。
“这是你爷爷。”李毅年看着有些迟疑的李君肃，出来解释。
“我也要去。”没等李君肃回答，李君意就抱着李君肃的胳膊。
“那你就跟着我们吧。”李清风转头看着躲在最後面的李君豪。
“出发，猫头鹰。”李君意看着李君肃笑嘻嘻的开口。
她之前抓住过一只雕鴞，君肃非说那是猫头鹰，李君意觉得挺贴切的，也就这麽叫了。
“武伯，保护好意姐。”李君肃转头看着李武拜托道。
content_en:
Bloody Night in Qingfeng City
woods
The black unknown objects moved quickly in groups. Only when they got closer did they realize that they were actually human figures.
"Warriors are indeed much easier to use than soldiers." Li Junsu thought as he looked at the warriors who were barely breathing.
"Let's go." Then, Li Junsu looked at the dark night in the distance and said.
Qingfeng City, city gate.
"Is it okay to open the city gate now?" one guard asked another guard.
"Let's stay away from the matters above." Another guard said vaguely.
Then, they saw black shadows coming from a distance, and then rushed towards the city gate.
"Qingfeng City is going to change."
Li family, outside the gate.
"Here we come." Li Yinian said calmly, looking at the dark figures coming in order from a distance.
Then, all the black shadows fell to the ground, and the young man at the head stood up.
"Head of the family, elder." Li Junsu looked at the people outside the gate and cupped their hands.
"Be careful!" Before Li Yinian and the others could answer, a figure rushed out and hugged Li Junsu.
No matter how different Li Junsu was, she would still be worried.
"Sister Yi, I'm back." Li Junsu struggled as he felt the familiar embrace.
Then, Li Qingfeng looked at Li Yinian, and the elders also looked at Li Yinian.
"Well, it's normal for children to have a good relationship." Li Yinian said bravely.
He also discovered that the good relationship between Li Junyi and Shen Xing was a bit too good.
But Qingfeng Li nodded noncommittally. These two little guys knew what was right.
Especially this eagle owl.
"Master, please give the order." Li Junsu persuaded Li Junyi to come down, and then knelt down on one knee.
"Get up first. Do you want to go to the Lin family first?" Li Qingfeng looked at his handsome grandson and said with satisfaction.
This child, if you want, the older generation's separated parents will have an attack.
"Yes, the head of the Lin family is not weak. To encircle and suppress the Chu family, the high end is more useful than the low end." Li Junsu lowered his head and listed the pros and cons.
"And Qingfeng City only needs one Li family." Li Junsu said his true thoughts.
"A good Qingfeng City only needs the Li family. Li Wu, the third and fourth sons, you and Eagle Owl go to the Lin family." Li Qingfeng laughed after hearing this.
"As for the second child, you and Xiaonian will surround the Chu family. Once the Chu family is alerted, take action." Li Qingfeng waved his hand.
"Remember, fight quickly." Li Qingfeng looked at Li Junsu and warned.
"This is your grandfather." Li Yinian looked at Li Junsu who was hesitant and came out to explain.
"I'm going too." Before Li Junsu could answer, Li Junyi hugged Li Junsu's arm.
"Then just follow us." Li Qingfeng turned to look at Li Junhao who was hiding at the back.
"Let's go, owl." Li Junyi looked at Li Junsu and said with a smile.
She had caught an eagle owl before, and Jun Sufei said it was an owl. Li Junyi thought it was quite appropriate, so she called it that way.
"Uncle Wu, protect Sister Haoyi." Li Junsu turned to look at Li Wu and asked.
